newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Heng Fung to place shares at HK$0.50 each.
newsitem.headline: Heng Fung to place shares at HK$0.50 each.

text.p: Heng Fung Holdings Co Ltd said on Friday it would place 77.60 million new shares with independent investors at HK$0.50 a share after terminating a placement arrangement made earlier this month.
The company said in a statement that the earlier arrangement had involved the same amout of shares but at an issue price of HK$0.42 per share. It gave no details on the termination.
Heng Fung said the new shares, which represent 16.52 percent of its enlarged share capital, would raise net proceeds of about HK$37.80 million to be used for general working capital.

On completion of the deal, the shareholding of its executive director Ng Mok Yuen would be diluted to 20.17 percent from 24.17, and the stake of chairman Chan Heng Fai and his wife Chan Yoke Keow would be reduced to 15.56 percent from 18.64, it said.
Trading in Heng Fung shares was suspended on Thursday and was due to resume on Friday. The stock closed at HK$0.55 on Wednesday.
